name: needs-triage
description: New issue or PR that still needs scope, priority, or owner.

name: blocked
description: Blocked by another PR, external dependency, missing decision, or failing prerequisite.

name: ready-to-merge
description: CI green, reviewed, and safe to merge.

name: status/in-progress
description: Actively being implemented.

name: status/ready-for-review
description: Author says the PR is ready for human review.

name: status/changes-requested
description: Reviewer requested changes that must be addressed before merge.

name: status/needs-rebase
description: Branch is stale, dirty, or needs conflict resolution against main.

name: status/ci-failing
description: One or more required checks are failing.

name: status/draft
description: Draft work. Do not merge until marked ready.

name: status/research
description: Research, design, ADR, or architecture decision before implementation.

name: P0
description: Critical: production outage, data loss, security incident, or blocked release.

name: P1
description: High priority: core user flow or current milestone.

name: P2
description: Medium priority: important but has workaround or can be scheduled.

name: P3
description: Low priority: polish, edge case, or backlog.

name: type/bug
description: Fixes incorrect behavior.

name: type/feature
description: Adds user-visible capability.

name: type/docs
description: Documentation-only or documentation-first change.

name: type/refactor
description: Improves structure without intended behavior change.

name: type/test
description: Adds or updates tests.

name: type/security
description: Security hardening, vulnerability fix, or private security follow-up.

name: type/dependencies
description: Dependency update from Dependabot or manual dependency maintenance.

name: area/frontend
description: Angular frontend, UI state, routing, or client API.

name: area/backend
description: Spring Boot backend, domain logic, API, or persistence.

name: area/database
description: PostgreSQL schema, Flyway migration, indexes, or query behavior.

name: area/infra
description: Docker, Caddy, GitHub Actions, deploy, cloud, or repository operations.

name: area/auth
description: Authentication, Google login, JWT, session, or role guard.

name: area/video
description: Video ingest, adaptive playback, R2, Shaka, offline video, or media edge.

name: area/pwa
description: PWA, service worker, IndexedDB, offline download, or sync.

name: area/payment
description: VNPay, SePay, course access activation, or payment settings.

name: area/admin
description: System admin workflows, settings, logs, and platform operations.

name: area/org-admin
description: Organization admin workflows and restricted operational admin behavior.

name: area/teacher
description: Teacher portal, authoring, grading, classes, or course management.

name: area/student
description: Learner portal, browse, learning, progress, assignments, or certificates.

name: area/docs
description: Documentation structure, runbooks, references, or diagrams.

name: risk/security
description: Needs security-focused review before merge.

name: risk/migration
description: Touches migration, data shape, or rollback-sensitive schema behavior.

name: risk/public-api
description: Changes API contract used by FE, mobile/PWA, or external integrations.

name: risk/production
description: Can affect deploy, uptime, media delivery, or live user access.

name: size/XS
description: Tiny change, typically under 50 lines.

name: size/S
description: Small change, usually easy to review in one pass.

name: size/M
description: Medium change requiring focused review.

name: size/L
description: Large change. Consider splitting if review quality drops.

name: size/XL
description: Very large change. Should normally be split before merge.

name: agent/codex
description: Implemented or reviewed with Codex assistance.

name: agent/claude
description: Implemented or reviewed with Claude assistance.

name: breaking-change
description: Breaking API, schema, runtime, or workflow change.

name: dependencies
description: Dependency updates and dependency maintenance.

name: security
description: Security-related issue, PR, or private disclosure follow-up.
